text:
mike (CS): FYI — Acme reported that after rotating their API key this morning, chat/generation requests are getting 403. Embeddings still succeed. They saw this on staging and prod. Repro steps below, escalating to eng :exclamation:

emma (CS): Can you paste the curl and the exact response? Also send the key id (redact token) so we can inspect claims.

mike (CS): Sure — key id: key_01GABCDEFxxx (redacted).
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "insufficient_scopes",
  "message": "token missing required scope: inference.generate"
}
```
Repro notes: same request with embedding endpoint works: POST /v1/embeddings returns 200.

raj (Eng): That error strongly implies the token claims don't include any inference scopes — looks like only embedding scopes were granted. Could be a provisioning mapping problem when SSO keys are created. @taylor can you run a claims inspect for `key_01GABCDEFxxx`?

taylor (SRE): Running inspect now: `rbx-cli keys inspect --key-id key_01GABCDEFxxx --env prod`
Output (redacted):
```
{
  "key_id": "key_01GABCDEFxxx",
  "owner": "acme-inc",
  "scopes": ["embeddings.read","embeddings.create"],
  "created_by": "ssoprovisioner@acme"
}
```
Yep — no inference scopes.

taylor (SRE): Quick root cause: the SCIM/SCV provisioning mapping for the role the customer had maps to `embeddings.*` only. During the recent provisioning schema change we accidentally stopped including `inference.generate` for the "app_writer" role when the request originated from some SSO sources. I can patch the mapper in the provisioner. Rolling a fix to staging now, will schedule prod patch after validation.

raj (Eng): Workaround for the customer: generate a temporary service key with full scopes (we can create one via the internal key-admin endpoint). Command we used internally:
```
POST /internal/v1/keys
{
  "owner":"acme-inc",
  "scopes":["inference.generate","inference.stream","embeddings.read","embeddings.create"],
  "note":"temp temp fix for chat outage"
}
```
That key should restore chat while we fix provisioning. Ensure audit log and TTL set.

emma (CS): Shared the workaround and temp key with Acme; they confirmed chat generation is back up with the temp key :thumbsup:. They want to know the permanent fix and whether we rotated anything on their side.

taylor (SRE): Not rotating anything on customer side. We'll update provisioning mapping and re-run the repro to ensure new keys get inference scopes. ETA for prod patch: 3 hours after staging verification. I'll also add a short migration script to backfill recent keys created in the window where mapping was wrong.

raj (Eng): Please also add a monitoring alert to detect keys created with mismatched scope sets (e.g., embeddings-only but used for generation) — that would catch regressions earlier.

mike (CS): Acme confirmed the temp key solved it and they're unblocked. They've asked for a postmortem once patched. I'll keep them updated. Closing on this thread when prod patch lands. :eyes:

emma (CS): Thanks team. Logging follow-up ticket for root-cause & backfill: CS-4521.

taylor (SRE): Patch deployed to staging and verified. Prod patch scheduled. Backfill job queued.

mike (CS): Confirmed with customer after 16:34 UTC — everything green. Marking resolved on our side. :white_check_mark:
